description: This Java source file defines the ContainerConfig class in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.container package. It manages container configurations by parsing XML elements, storing configurations statically, and providing access methods for configuration properties. It includes nested classes for Configuration and Property, representing container configurations and their properties respectively.

classes.name: ContainerConfig
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to manage container configurations, parse XML configurations, and retrieve properties.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration
classes.description: Nested static class representing a single container configuration, including properties like name, className, loaders, and properties map.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration.Property
classes.description: Nested static class representing individual configuration properties, including name, value, and potential child properties.

methods.name: ContainerConfig.getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieve a container configuration by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: ContainerConfig.getConfigurations
methods.description: Parse and retrieve a list of container configurations from an XML element.

methods.name: ContainerConfig.getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieve property values by name with default fallback, supporting String, int, and boolean types.
